contentPattern.structure: product image(s) + title + rating + description + swatches + price + CTAs

suitableFor: product detail pages with image on left and info on right
product pages with multiple variant images
PDP layouts with price and CTA buttons
two-column layouts with dominant image column
notSuitableFor: promotional banners with single image and tagline
multi-row column layouts with equal content
text-heavy comparison layouts without product images
layouts where both columns have similar content weight
